# Actual Scala binder/body-parser error goldens

Captured on2026-10-12 from the isolated actual Scala datastore at127.0.0.1:19491, Play3.0.11 production mode, with no user token or production data. `scala_http.json` records requests, Accept, status and headers (Date omitted); `.body` files contain exact response bytes. Four Accept variants (text/html, application/json, text/plain, */*) give the same HTML for each ObjectId, missing query, Int, Boolean and escaped-path binding failure. JSON schema{} gives structural400 JSON without Action.fox cache/CORS; wrong content-type gives415 HTML; malformed `{` shows Jackson's detailed400 HTML.

Cached artifact `org/playframework/play_3/3.0.11/play_3-3.0.11.jar` was independently inspected with `javap -c -p` for `play.api.http.DefaultHttpErrorHandler`, `views.html.defaultpages.badRequest$` and `play.api.mvc.QueryStringBindable$bindableInt$`. Default handler invokes Twirl's template unconditionally, without Accept negotiation. The template's staticHTML plus individually escaped method, URI and message slots matches the captured HTML; CSS uses the helper/style template. ObjectId binding message comes from util/src/main/scala/com/scalableminds/util/objectid/ObjectId.scala.

`play_bad_request.template.html` is the captured full template with only the dynamic detail replaced by `{{DETAIL}}`; Rust embeds the full static template in binding_errors.rs without a runtime fixture dependency. Router tests check exact HTML bytes against independent captures, not against the implementation template. Apostrophe, ampersand, angle brackets and quotes were independently sent through an encoded path and checked against Scala Twirl escaping.

Malformed JSON diagnostics remain a known difference: Rust renders the sameHTML handler envelope but preserves the actual serde_json diagnostic. No lone-body hardcode or fabricated Jackson position/message is used. Parser diagnostic equivalence requires a separately verified parser adapter. These captures do not prove general parser parity, all route binder types, Java Unicode numeric parsing or all route binder evaluation ordering.
